# 문제 ## 1. 무방향 그래프 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-818e-af64-d3c4a597f142/56a33e83cb7878c8.webp) ## 2. 방향 그래프 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-818e-af64-d3c4a597f142/a901941ef61d09ec.webp) ## 3. 가중치 방향 그래프 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-818e-af64-d3c4a597f142/3df1b63a983a6cf2.webp) # 풀이 ## 1) 무방향 그래프 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-818e-af64-d3c4a597f142/0d151dc9b36a0031.webp)
입력값 ```java 5 5 1 2 1 3 3 4 4 2 2 5 ```
### 구현1) 이중 배열(int[][]) ```java import java.lang.reflect.Array; import java.util.*; public class Main { static int n, m; static int[][] graph; public static void main(String args[]) { Main T = new Main(); Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); n = sc.nextInt(); m = sc.nextInt(); graph = new int[n + 1][n + 1]; for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { int a = sc.nextInt(); int b = sc.nextInt(); graph[a][b] = 1; graph[b][a] = 1; } System.out.println(graph); System.out.println(); } } ``` ### 구현2) 이중 ArrayList ```java import java.lang.reflect.Array; import java.util.*; public class Main { static int n, m; static ArrayList> graph; public static void main(String args[]) { Main T = new Main(); Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); n = sc.nextInt(); m = sc.nextInt(); graph = new ArrayList>(); for(int i=0; i<=n; i++){ graph.add(new ArrayList()); } for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { int a = sc.nextInt(); int b = sc.nextInt(); graph.get(a).add(b); graph.get(b).add(a); } System.out.println(graph); System.out.println(); } } ``` ## 2) 방향 그래프 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-818e-af64-d3c4a597f142/32f4c962bf4275d1.webp)
입력값 ```java 5 5 1 2 1 3 3 4 4 2 2 5 ```
### 구현1) 이중배열(int[][]) ```java import java.lang.reflect.Array; import java.util.*; public class Main { static int n, m; static int[][] graph; public static void main(String args[]) { Main T = new Main(); Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); n = sc.nextInt(); m = sc.nextInt(); graph = new int[n + 1][n + 1]; for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { int a = sc.nextInt(); int b = sc.nextInt(); graph[a][b] = 1; } System.out.println(graph); System.out.println(); } } ``` ### 구현2) 이중 ArrayList ```java import java.lang.reflect.Array; import java.util.*; public class Main { static int n, m; static ArrayList> graph; public static void main(String args[]) { Main T = new Main(); Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); n = sc.nextInt(); m = sc.nextInt(); graph = new ArrayList>(); for(int i=0; i<=n; i++){ graph.add(new ArrayList()); } for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { int a = sc.nextInt(); int b = sc.nextInt(); graph.get(a).add(b); } System.out.println(graph); System.out.println(); } } ``` ## 3) 가중치 방향 그래프 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/17397ef27e1f8dc4ecc8b5fec0ed678f6e723500/posts/1c3eda9b-0fe1-818e-af64-d3c4a597f142/767e0c13cdab8ceb.webp)
입력값 ```java 5 5 1 2 2 1 3 4 3 4 5 4 2 2 2 5 5 ```
### 구현1) 이중배열 ```java import java.lang.reflect.Array; import java.util.*; public class Main { static int n, m; static int[][] graph; public static void main(String args[]) { Main T = new Main(); Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in); n = sc.nextInt(); m = sc.nextInt(); graph = new int[n + 1][n + 1]; for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) { int a = sc.nextInt(); int b = sc.nextInt(); int c = sc.nextInt(); graph[a][b] = c; } System.out.println(graph); System.out.println(); } } ```
